description: Owner analytics for an embed: totals across its visits for a date range. Returns KPIs (sessions, unique and returning visitors, identified viewers, average active time, media opens, time watched, questions and sessions with questions), sessions and visitors per day, top traffic sources, and a paged table of media with opens, unique viewers, plays, time watched, completion rate, questions and downloads.

embedId.description: The embed's _id (24 hex characters), as returned by create_embed or check_embed

from.description: Only sessions started on or after this time (ISO 8601 date)

includeOwner.description: Include sessions from people signed in to your own Speak AI workspace (default false)

to.description: Only sessions started on or before this time (ISO 8601 date)

traffic.description: people leaves out bots, bots shows only bots (default all)

tz.description: IANA time zone used to group by day, e.g. America/Toronto (default UTC)

name: get_embed_session_summary

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Get Embed Session Summary
